items.title: Adobe Powers a New Era of Creativity, Bringing Agents and Tools to Creatives Wherever and However They Create
items.excerpt: Adobe MAX 2026 keynote release: Creative Agent expands across Firefly and Creative Cloud, a local MCP preview lets third-party agents edit native Photoshop/Illustrator/Premiere/After Effects files, Firefly Builder (private beta) turns prompts into on-brand interactive prototypes, plus Google and Microsoft partnerships.

items.title: Adobe Firefly Expands as the AI Creative Studio, Bringing Adobe's Trusted Creative Tools to Every Creator
items.excerpt: Firefly adds Creative Agent across its editors, Quick Actions, Firefly Graph (beta) for repeatable node workflows, and new video, design and image tools including a design-to-code prototyping preview. (Time from Google News; page shows date only.)

items.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
items.excerpt: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new Firefly prototype builder that generates interactive sites and apps from prompts, and launches a local MCP so outside AI agents can drive Creative Cloud apps.

items.title: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI
items.excerpt: Third-party AI agents can now operate Creative Cloud apps for you, and Firefly's AI Assistant can even run social media accounts, as Adobe reorients MAX 2026 around agents.

items.title: Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere are making it easier to remove things
items.excerpt: Rundown of the new AI editing and design tools in Creative Cloud and Firefly from MAX 2026, led by smarter object/distraction removal across Photoshop, Lightroom and Premiere.

items.title: Adobe unveils Photoshop 2027 with a host of new AI features
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq's look at Photoshop 2027: the Creative Agent and new generative features aimed at clearing busywork from retouching and compositing.

items.title: Adobe wants an AI agent to do your Premiere Pro editing
items.excerpt: A Creative Agent revealed at Adobe MAX comes to Premiere Pro to take on the boring editing jobs, shifting editors toward directing an agent.

items.title: Adobe's Google partnership hints at a radically different future for Photoshop
items.excerpt: Adobe and Google DeepMind are exploring a customised Google image model for Photoshop that would allow near-real-time text-prompt edits and variation switching without breaking flow; exploratory, no release date.

items.title: Adobe releases Photoshop 28.0
items.excerpt: Big Photoshop update adds eye-catching AI relighting, trace erase and Generative Recompose; CG Channel details how the features work. (Time from RSS.)

items.title: Adobe releases After Effects 27.0
items.excerpt: After Effects 27.0 brings changes to the 3D toolset and a new agentic AI Assistant for compositing and motion graphics work. (Time from RSS.)

items.title: Otoy releases OctaneRender 2027.1 in beta
items.excerpt: OctaneRender 2027.1 Beta 1 adds an MCP Server so AI tools can build and render scenes in the GPU renderer. (Article originally posted March 2026, updated for Beta 1; time from RSS.)

items.title: Introducing AI Assistant (beta) | Adobe Creative Cloud
items.excerpt: Adobe's official intro to AI Assistant (beta), now across Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects, Illustrator and InDesign.

items.title: What's New in Adobe Illustrator and InDesign | Adobe Creative Cloud
items.excerpt: Official walkthrough of the MAX release for Illustrator and InDesign, including the new AI Assistant (beta) for repetitive layout and vector tasks.

items.title: Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview Is Out & It Was Built With AI
items.excerpt: Epic's UE 5.9 Preview is the first engine release built primarily with agentic workflows: a handful of people directed fleets of agents to port UE6 AI tooling and add Web as a platform, ahead of the Epic AI MegaJam.

items.title: 6 easy ways to use the Figma agent right now
items.excerpt: Figma's guide to six practical uses of its on-canvas design agent, from making designs more expressive and automating busywork to exploring more options on the canvas.

items.title: Open your apps in Claude and work in them together
items.excerpt: Claude's interactive connectors (built on MCP Apps) now open beside the chat or full screen: Adobe for photo retouching/effects, Canva, Webflow, Vercel and others, with Figma and Shopify building integrations. (Date-only in JSON-LD.)

items.title: Working with Claude Sheets, Whiteboards, and Interactive Connectors
items.excerpt: Anthropic introduces Claude Whiteboards and Sheets (beta, all paid plans) as new artifact surfaces alongside Claude Docs, Slides, Design and Motion, plus upgraded interactive connectors. (Date-only in JSON-LD.)

items.title: Trimble expands AI capabilities across construction lifecycle
items.excerpt: Trimble adds AI tools spanning generative design, jobsite diagnostics, automated inspections and contract risk analysis, with AI agents in Trimble Connect and governance features.

items.title: Creality's new mBox is an AI-enabled 3D printer for kids
items.excerpt: Creality's $329 mBox is a compact, AI-enabled 3D printer designed for children, sold via TikTok Shop in the US. AI depth to be verified.

items.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
items.excerpt: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling-tower engineering drawings; engineers find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes instead of nearly an hour. (Page 403; time and text from OpenAI RSS.)

items.title: Animaj Unveils FlipMove AI Animation Workflow
items.excerpt: Animaj (Pocoyo, Maya the Bee) unveils FlipMove, an artist-led AI system that carries scenes from approved animatic to finished animation, already in production on 'Ozzy Fox'. Off-list outlet.

items.title: Framestore Brings Hybrid AI/VFX to Sky's Christmas Campaign
items.excerpt: Framestore's Sky Christmas spot used new AI tools built into its pipeline for previs and character removal alongside CG environments. Off-list outlet; check marketing dup.
